content: Auto-resolve vs manual (Total War: Warhammer, CA + Steam forums, cross-checked): auto is a simplified calc that over-values ranged (ignores ammo), under-values armor/resistances; losses spread evenly across the army instead of concentrated on exposed units; auto guarantees total annihilation of the loser while manual rarely wipes full stacks; loot keyed to enemy casualties so auto pays MORE; prediction shown up front kills motivation to fight. Proposed fixes: more variance in balanced fights, auto-resolve penalty, allow survivors, better chase mechanics.
